prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: ONE Copywriter avatar for Spectron's established cyberpunk human–cyber hybrid collection.
Input image: STYLE, MATERIAL QUALITY, LIGHTING AND FRAMING reference only. Create a new character with a clearly different face, hairstyle and eyewear. Do not retain the reference's VR visor or long brown hair.

Character: a witty adult woman around 30–35, a creative copywriter with an observant, slightly mischievous expression. Light warm skin with subtle freckles, natural green-gray eyes, expressive brows, a small knowing closed-mouth half-smile. Natural mature human proportions, no exaggerated cute features.
Signature silhouette: a COPPER-RED, slightly tousled chin-length bob, softly layered with an off-center part and one side tucked behind the ear. The whole crown fits inside the frame. A slim graphite writing stylus tucked behind the exposed ear gives a discreet copywriter cue.
Eyewear: round dark-bronze smart glasses, two CLEAR lenses through which both eyes are fully visible, a fine metal bridge and precise small titanium temple hinges with tiny cyan indicators. Stylish practical reading glasses with cybernetic engineering, not goggles, dark sunglasses or a VR visor. Keep lenses mostly free of glare and reflections, no interface or lettering visible inside them.
Human–cyber integration: a small elegant flush graphite-and-titanium implant along the exposed temple, a subtle fine mechanical seam toward the cheek, a compact augmented ear interface and one cyan status light at the collar. Predominantly human face; cybernetics are refined accents, non-gory and neatly integrated.
Wardrobe: the collection's tactile charcoal technical jacket with a sculptural raised collar, a muted copper shoulder inset, small brushed-metal fasteners and restrained cyan detailing. An ivory high-neck inner layer gives her a slightly editorial, creative look. No logos, badges or decorative text.
Pose and framing: STRICTLY FRONTAL head-and-shoulders portrait, head upright without tilt, shoulders square and level, gaze directly into camera. Match reference scale and upper-chest crop. Leave roughly 8–10 percent top safety margin; face and round glasses centered for circular or rounded-square avatar crops.
Background: fully opaque solid vivid CORAL, target #EB614F, filling the square and all four corners. Coral rather than violet or magenta. No scenery, gradient, pattern, spotlight circle or vignette.
Rendering: exactly the collection's premium detailed stylized 3D game-character portrait, sculpted human facial planes, naturally shaded freckled skin, detailed copper hair, realistic cloth, brushed metal and clear optical glass. Soft warm-neutral studio key with restrained cool rim lighting. Clean continuous silhouette, distinct legible identity at small UI sizes.
No glitch effects, floating fragments, pixel displacement, chromatic doubling, holograms, face mask, large cybernetic eye, huge anime eyes, chibi/cute proportions, wide grin, text, watermark, frame, extra characters, hands or multi-panel layout. One square avatar only.
